decision.rationale: Prior fits on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 show sensor_lag training RMSE 0.079 vs 0.42 for linear/quadratic_loss, but training fit cannot establish mechanism or future accuracy. Action-2 staggered probe RMSE 0.075 and action-3 alternate probe RMSE 0.082 show no_mismatch_observed for initial model, with no recorded mismatches. Refit sensor_lag numerically on all five observations before spending remaining 2 physical experiments; proposals do not run experiments.
